name: B10-0589/2025 (Renew) – Arbitrary arrest and sentencing of academics Bahruz Samadov and Igbal Abilov in Azerbaijan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the arbitrary arrest and sentencing of academics Bahruz Samadov and Igbal Abilov in Azerbaijan
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Azerbaijan to release two academics, Bahruz Samadov and Igbal Abilov, who were jailed for 15 and 18 years on charges the Parliament says were made up. It also condemns the arrest of opposition leader Ali Karimli and asks Azerbaijan to free all political prisoners. The Parliament wants the European Union to consider sanctions on officials responsible and to tie any future partnership deal to progress on human rights.

- The Parliament asks Azerbaijan to free Samadov, Abilov, Karimli and all political prisoners.
- It asks the European Union to consider sanctions on Azerbaijani officials and link any future partnership deal to human rights progress.
- The resolution is an opinion; it does not itself change any law or release anyone.
